# Emergent Mind

> A frontier research discovery platform that transforms arXiv papers into visual explanations and open problem databases for AI researchers.

Emergent Mind aggregates cutting-edge AI research and makes it accessible through interactive whiteboards, video explainers, and curated problem collections. The platform focuses on breakthrough areas like language models, state-space architectures, multimodal learning, reinforcement learning, and AI safety.

## Key Topics

- arXiv research discovery
- Language models (LLM)
- Mamba-3 state-space models
- Reinforcement learning
- Attention mechanisms
- Multimodal learning
- AI safety
- Efficient inference
- Whiteboard explanations
- Open problems
- Paper recommendations
- Frontier research
- GLM-OCR
- World models
- Vision language agents (VLA)

## Core Platform

- [Emergent Mind: Frontier Research Explorer](https://www.emergentmind.com): Homepage for Emergent Mind arXiv research discovery platform
- [Whiteboards](https://www.emergentmind.com/whiteboards): Visual whiteboard explainers of arXiv research papers
- [Open Problems](https://www.emergentmind.com/open-problems): Database of open problems from research papers

## Video Research Explainers

- [Mamba-3: Complex Rotations and Efficient State-Space Modeling](https://www.emergentmind.com/videos/mamba-3-advanced-state-space-sequence-models-ac7a3d01): Video on Mamba-3 state space model architecture breakthroughs
- [Training Agents Inside of Scalable World Models](https://www.emergentmind.com/videos/dreamer-4-scalable-world-model-agents-a3dcfb94): Video on Dreamer 4 world models for offline reinforcement learning
- [Mixture-of-Depths Attention: Unlocking Deep Transformers](https://www.emergentmind.com/videos/mixture-of-depths-attention-in-llms-83c89133): Video explainer on Mixture-of-Depths Attention mechanism
- [Attention Residuals: Selective Depth-Wise Aggregation for Deep Language Models](https://www.emergentmind.com/videos/attention-residuals-in-deep-language-models-ebdd8b0f): Video on Attention Residuals mechanism for deep neural networks
- [GLM-OCR: High-Fidelity Document Understanding at 0.9 Billion Parameters](https://www.emergentmind.com/videos/glm-ocr-compact-multimodal-ocr-model-2f5c0881): Video on GLM-OCR compact multimodal document intelligence model
- [A Theory of Multimodal Learning](https://www.emergentmind.com/videos/a-theory-of-multimodal-learning-0a1721f1): Video on theoretical foundations of multimodal learning advantages
- [OpenClaw-RL: Train Any Agent Simply by Talking](https://www.emergentmind.com/videos/openclaw-rl-online-rl-for-personalized-agents-69528f77): Video on OpenClaw-RL framework for online agent personalization

## AI Safety & Training Topics

- [Multi-Agent Risks from Advanced AI](https://www.emergentmind.com/videos/multi-agent-risks-from-advanced-ai-b1c598a5): Video on multi-agent AI safety risks and mitigation strategies
- [Ghosts of Softmax: Complex Singularities That Limit Safe Step Sizes in Cross-Entropy](https://www.emergentmind.com/videos/ghosts-of-softmax-singularities-in-cross-entropy-e44e5be5): Video on softmax singularities and neural network training stability
- [Evaluation Format, Not Model Capability, Drives Triage Failure in Consumer Health AI](https://www.emergentmind.com/videos/evaluation-format-drives-triage-failure-in-health-ai-65e5061f): Video on AI health triage evaluation methodology and clinical safety
